products.title: DEFY
products.blurb: Command the Meridian Concord or the Ashpact Horde in real-time warfare for up to eight commanders. Every supply node runs dry, so the map forces you to move, fight and commit. Choose a doctrine, launch superweapons, and live with what you chose. The war remembers.

products.title: DEFY - The Harrow
products.blurb: Play the Harrow. They came up through the deepest survey bore, sealed in pressurised carapaces, and they are not conquering this continent: they are processing it. Harvest the dead for Charge, hide inside your own vapour and take the enemy's machines home.

products.title: DEFY - Delugen Reach
products.blurb: Take the Delugen Reach to war: amphibious assault, hydraulic pressure and corrosive saltwater ordnance from the drowned western lowlands. A new nation for DEFY with three sects, a superweapon ladder built on the Tidal Engine and an army that erodes the enemy rather than breaking it.

products.title: DEFY - Galecrest Sovereignty
products.blurb: Command the Galecrest Sovereignty, the fastest army in DEFY and the most fragile. Wind, sonic and lightning weapons, glider air power and turbine cities that never lost power. Strike like a storm front, disengage before the enemy can answer, and never stand still.

products.title: DEFY - Halomere Syndicate
products.blurb: Field the Halomere Syndicate: eleven salvage houses from the drained Rosemarch Pans. Few, expensive, heavily shielded units whose radiological weapons keep killing after the fight ends, powered by the largest energy surplus in DEFY. Nothing on that field is scrap.

products.title: DEFY - Aphelion Vigil
products.blurb: Command the Aphelion Vigil, the people who saw the Severance coming and were ignored. The best optics and the longest guns in DEFY, on thin, slow-firing platforms that out-range their own sight. Put spotters forward, measure once and fire once.

products.title: DEFY - Ironveil Dominion
products.blurb: Bring the Ironveil Dominion down from the mountains: the thickest plating and the toughest buildings in DEFY, siege artillery that out-ranges every turret, and a walking fortress. Slow, heavy and unstoppable once committed. Your enemy's only hope is to starve the column.

products.title: DEFY - Pyralis Covenant
products.blurb: Burn the old world down with the Pyralis Covenant: incendiary saturation, thermite and plasma from the volcanic rift. Wildfire that spreads, lines of fire instead of walls, and a superweapon that ends in a lava field. They are not conquerors. They are refiners.

products.title: DEFY - Syntheq Enclave
products.blurb: Run the Syntheq Enclave: networked drones, electronic warfare and information dominance from a megacity under the eastern seaboard. See first, disable before you destroy, hijack what you need, and never fight a battle you have not modelled.

products.title: DEFY - Verdance Commune
products.blurb: Grow the Verdance Commune from the Greenmarch: an underground people whose machines are cultivated, not built. Spores that keep working after the shooting stops, root snares that hold an army still, and ground vehicles that burrow and surface wherever they choose.

products.title: DEFY - Urban Warfare
products.blurb: Take DEFY's war into the city. Every building can be held, shot to pieces and brought down: four stages of damage, garrisons in the windows, towers that topple toward their fall side and bury the street in rubble, and fire that guts a block from the inside. The city fights back.

products.title: DEFY - Wild Weather
products.blurb: Fight DEFY's battles in the dark and the weather. Dawn fog that hides an army until it is on top of you, mist in the valleys, a day that turns to night mid-match, and low cloud that hides aircraft from everything but radar. Sight is the first casualty, and it decides the fight.

products.title: DEFY - Emberwake Convoy
products.blurb: Arm the Ashpact Horde with the Emberwake Convoy: a fuel-cracking yard that trains torch infantry, fast burner raiders and a deployable slag mortar, plus the accelerant that feeds them. Fire for the Horde's front line, and an answer to anyone who digs in.
